quizzes.title: India's medal haul at Glasgow 2026
quizzes.passage: The 23rd Commonwealth Games were held in Glasgow, Scotland, from 23 July to 2 August 2026. The Commonwealth Games are generally held once every four years, and the event is organised by the Commonwealth Games Federation. The sports programme included athletics, swimming, track cycling, weightlifting, bowls, artistic gymnastics, boxing and judo, among others. India's contingent included para-athletes. For India, the medal count at Glasgow is best read against its performance at the previous edition, held in Birmingham in 2022. Boxing was India's best-performing sport at the Games, and Indian women boxers won several gold medals in their weight categories. Athletes from India also recorded historic firsts in judo and weightlifting. The medal table ranks nations by their gold, silver and bronze medals, and a country's position on that table is used to compare overall results. The booklet describes India's campaign sport by sport, beginning with the boxing results and the firsts achieved by individual athletes. The booklet also reports India's results across several sports, in addition to its overall medal count, and it includes a separate account of the notable performers at the Games. Each medal is awarded for an event on the programme, and the medal table adds up the medals that each nation has won across all of those events.

questions.q: What was India's position on the medal tally at Glasgow 2026?
questions.explanation: India finished 4th on the medal tally, behind Australia, England and Canada.

questions.q: Which country finished immediately ahead of India on the Glasgow 2026 medal tally?
questions.explanation: Canada was placed directly above India, which finished behind Australia, England and Canada.

questions.q: How many medals did India win in boxing at Glasgow 2026?
questions.explanation: Boxing produced 10 medals for India, made up of 7 gold and 3 silver.

questions.q:
Examine the assertion and reason given below.
Assertion (A): India won fewer medals at Glasgow 2026 than it won at Birmingham 2022.
Reason (R): India did not field teams in 3x3 Basketball or Netball at Glasgow 2026.
options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Both statements are true, but the booklet attributes the lower count to a reduced contingent and absent disciplines, not to the team absences.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Total medals India won at Glasgow 2026   ->   A. 61
II. Total medals India won at Birmingham 2022   ->   B. 3
III. Boxing gold medals at Glasgow 2026   ->   C. 39
IV. Boxing silver medals at Glasgow 2026   ->   D. 7
questions.explanation: India won 39 medals at Glasgow, 61 at Birmingham, 7 boxing gold and 3 boxing silver.

questions.q:
Read the statements below about India at Glasgow 2026:
I. India won 61 medals at the Birmingham 2022 Games.
II. India did not field teams in 3x3 Basketball or Netball at Glasgow 2026.
III. India's medal total at Glasgow 2026 included 17 gold medals.
Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statements I and II are stated in the booklet, while India won 13 gold medals, not 17, at Glasgow 2026.

questions.q:
How many of the statements below are correct?
I. India won 13 gold medals at Glasgow 2026.
II. India won 3 silver medals in boxing at Glasgow 2026.
III. India finished 5th on the Glasgow 2026 medal tally.
questions.explanation: India's gold tally was 13 and its boxing silver count was 3, but India finished 4th, not 5th.

quizzes.title: Notable Indian achievements at Glasgow 2026
quizzes.passage: The 23rd Commonwealth Games were held in Glasgow, Scotland, from 23 July to 2 August 2026, and brought athletes from many nations into one multi-sport programme. The Commonwealth Games are generally held once every four years, and the event is organised by the Commonwealth Games Federation. The idea of a Commonwealth-wide sporting competition can be traced to 1911. The booklet highlights individual athletes who produced notable performances, and it records several historic results for Indian competitors at this edition. Boxing was one of the sports in which Indian athletes performed strongly, and women boxers from India won gold medals in their events. The booklet also describes a weightlifter's results across several Games. In athletics, a javelin thrower from India took part in the men's event, returning to the Games after a gap in his participation. The Games also produced first-time results for Indian competitors, and the booklet lists these alongside the medal totals. India's contingent also included para-athletes. The booklet presents these results in a section on India's historic achievements. The Games are contested across a range of sports, and the booklet gives its account of Indian achievements alongside the overall medal figures for the event. This edition was the one held in Glasgow in 2026, and its results are the subject of the booklet's section on Indian achievements.

questions.q: Which Indian boxer won the Women's 57 kg boxing gold at Glasgow 2026?
questions.explanation: Jaismine Lamboria won the Women's 57 kg boxing gold.

questions.q: Which two Indian athletes became India's first-ever Commonwealth Games gold medallists in judo?
questions.explanation: Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh were India's first-ever Commonwealth Games gold medallists in judo.

questions.q: Which edition of the Commonwealth Games did Neeraj Chopra miss before returning at Glasgow 2026?
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra returned to the Commonwealth Games after missing Birmingham 2022.

questions.q:
Examine the assertion and reason given below.
Assertion (A): Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal in the men's javelin throw at Glasgow 2026.

options: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation: Neeraj Chopra won silver, not gold, in the men's javelin throw, while the flag reception in R is correctly stated.

questions.q:
Match List I with List II:
I. Mirabai Chanu   ->   A. Judo
II. Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh   ->   B. Javelin throw
III. Jaismine Lamboria   ->   C. Weightlifting
IV. Neeraj Chopra   ->   D. Boxing (57 kg)
questions.explanation: Mirabai Chanu is a weightlifter, Asmita Dey and Harsh Singh won judo gold, Jaismine Lamboria won boxing gold and Neeraj Chopra won javelin silver.

questions.q:

I. Five women boxers from India won gold at Glasgow 2026.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?
questions.explanation: Statement III is wrong because Mirabai Chanu had already won gold at Gold Coast 2018, so Glasgow 2026 was not her first.
